title: Normal Circuit vs. Short Circuit
description: The same battery, twice: once through a resistor at 27 mA, once through bare wire at about 6 A.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

educational.audience: Students and mentors before their first hands-on session

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a circuit diagram, the learner explains why a low-resistance path produces a current spike compared to a normal, resistor-limited path.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover any marker to compare the two loops component by component
pedagogical.assessment: Explain the current difference from the resistance alone.
